tools.name: recall_rp_memory
tools.description: Search for specific past details absent from supplied context when historical accuracy matters; do not use it to validate a new user development. Put all missing facets of one event in one request, then call again only for one essential gap after reading the result.

query.description: One self-contained event question with distinguishing people, place, time, action, or object cues; use the supplied memory language when known.

ref.description: Optional exact current-turn memory ref, such as m1. Use it when the supplied memory is the scene being questioned.

aspects.description: All missing details of that event as separate, self-contained questions in this single call (max 5).

intent.description: Optional emphasis: recall=events, relationship=relationships, promise=commitments, world_state=facts and beliefs, evidence=source wording. Other relevant evidence remains searchable.

tools.name: follow_rp_memory
tools.description: Request one essential still-missing detail from a memory ref returned in this turn. Name the exact gap and do not repeat evidence already returned.

intent.description: Optional emphasis: recall=events, relationship=relationships, promise=commitments, world_state=facts and beliefs, evidence=source wording. Other relevant evidence remains searchable.

ref.description: An exact memory ref supplied in this turn, such as m1.

query.description: Optional question about the missing detail of this memory.
